transcript: The Silk Road from ancient times Connected Asia in the East In Europe in the West It was not a single road But a network of many routes Chinese silk, Persian glass, Indian spices and Roman gold traveled this road by caravan Merchants loaded their camels and crossed deserts and mountains But it was not only goods that traveled this road Religion also spread along this path Buddhism spread from India to China Islam spread from Arabia into Central Asia Language and art were also exchanged The Chinese way of making paper traveled westward And later contributed to learning and culture in Europe The Silk Road was one of history's great networks of exchange The words carried by the desert wind across many centuries Still quietly support of many civilizations

segments.text: The Silk Road from ancient times
It was not a single road
But a network of many routes
Indian spices and Roman gold traveled this road by caravan
Merchants loaded their camels and crossed deserts and mountains
But it was not only goods that traveled this road
Religion also spread along this path
Buddhism spread from India to China
Islam spread from Arabia into Central Asia
Language and art were also exchanged
The Chinese way of making paper traveled westward
And later contributed to learning and culture in Europe
The Silk Road was one of history's great networks of exchange
The words carried by the desert wind across many centuries
Still quietly support of many civilizations
